meta.name: test-error-states
meta.description: Force the states a happy-path run never reaches (a failing API, an empty list, a slow request, a timeout, an expired session, a toast that auto-dismisses) and check the UI actually handles them. Use when error handling was written but never run, when a loading or empty state needs verifying, when a bug only happens on a slow connection, or when a timer, poll, debounce or retry needs testing without sleeping.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 强制触发失败接口、空列表、超时等异常状态,验证界面是否真的兜住
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果错误处理代码已经写好,却从没在真实异常下跑过。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if error handling is written but never actually exercised under real failures.

howto.what: 它能在运行中的 App 里强制制造正常流程走不到的状态——接口失败、空列表、超时、会话过期、自动消失的提示——并检查界面是否真的处理了；还能跳过等待时间验证定时器、轮询、重试。
howto.when: 当错误处理写了却没跑过、空或加载状态待验证、bug 只在慢网络出现，或要测定时器、轮询、重试时。网络模拟需租用或受驱动的浏览器，时钟不需要。

say.text: 把 /api/deploys 模拟成 500，再点重试，看错误提示有没有出现
say.note: 注入模拟后驱动流程并断言恢复

say.text: 冻结时钟并前进 5 秒，看提示是否自动消失
读一下当前 state，确认失败后没有残留乐观更新
say.note: 查的是 store，不只是界面

howto.what_en: It forces states a happy path never reaches in the running app — a failing API, an empty list, a timeout, an expired session, an auto-dismissing toast — and checks the UI actually handles them. It can also skip time instead of sleeping through timers.
howto.when_en: Use when error handling was written but never run, an empty or loading state needs verifying, or a bug only shows on a slow connection. Network mocking needs a driven or leased browser.

say_en.text: Mock /api/deploys as 500, then click retry and check the error banner
say_en.note: Injects the mock, then verifies recovery

say_en.text: Freeze the clock and advance 5s to see if the toast auto-dismisses
Read reticle_state to confirm no optimistic value survived the failure
say_en.note: Reads the store, not just the UI
